ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution with approximately 80% low-intensity (black) pixels and 20% high-intensity (white) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary low-intensity (black) pigmentation covers the central fluke area. High-intensity (white) regions are mapped to the distal tips of both lobes and a small bifurcated area at the peduncle base.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped median notch with a pixel-calculated acute angle and moderate depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Significant macro-irregularity including a deep jagged indentation on the inner right lobe; fine-scale serrations visible across the remaining trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge leading to pointed, slightly recurved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of small, high-intensity circular spots (scars) visible on the medial portion of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-contrast linear marks (rake marks) intersecting the pigmented boundary on both left and right distal sections.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable traumatic indentation/tissue loss on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe, distinct from the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of alphanumeric identifiers 'NAHWC #1579' and 'YoNAH #2708' in the image footer.
